description.value:
Requirement Your target is your Marked quarry.

Make a Strike against your Marked quarry. If it hits, the target is off-guard until the end of your next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: Note: the "must be your Marked quarry" clause is a *requirement to use the action* (player- enforced text, as real pf2e requirements almost always are — e.g. none of P4/P5's Requirement clauses are themselves rule-encoded), so this one is not primarily blocked by [NO-MARK]. The actual blocker is the "on hit, apply off-guard to the target for one round" behavior itself: real pf2e's closest analog (Tumble Behind, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/rogue/level-1/tumble-behind-rogue.json:34-44) applies off-guard as an EphemeralEffect scoped to *your own subsequent attack roll*, not as a condition placed on the target for anyone to see for a full round — that's a materially different (and currently unprecedented) persistent-condition-on-hit shape.
